summary: Join our training course on social protection data systems and performance monitoring. Gain essential skills to improve program effectiveness and outcomes.
lede: Training in social protection data systems and performance monitoring helps programme managers, monitoring specialists and analysts build usable evidence from programme records. Participants learn to validate and disaggregate records, map data flows between registries and management information systems, and select indicators for coverage, timeliness and outcomes. They also practise building KPI dashboards and turning findings into improvement actions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage, analyse, govern, or use social protection data systems and need stronger evidence for programme delivery, performance review, and policy decisions.
modules: Social Protection Systems and ILO Recommendation 202
Social Registries and Management Information Systems
Social Protection Reporting and Stakeholder Coordination
prerequisites: You should have working experience in social protection programme operations, monitoring and evaluation, social registries, management information systems, social policy, or administrative data analysis. Familiarity with spreadsheets and routine programme reporting will help, but coding or programming is not required. Advanced concepts such as interoperability, AI-assisted monitoring, and evaluation design are taught at conceptual and operational application levels rather than production engineering depth. Bring a laptop if you want to adapt the provided templates during exercises.
